content: We have conducted experiments with BERT in the two datasets of Spanish clinical narrative presented in Section SECREF3 The first experiment set uses NUBes-PHI, a corpus of real medical reports manually annotated with sensitive information. Because this corpus is not publicly available, and in order to compare the BERT-based model to other related published systems, the second set of experiments uses the MEDDOCAN 2019 shared task competition dataset. The following sections provide greater detail about the two experimental setups.
